# Repository Information

## Description
A comprehensive, production-ready courier logistics management system with intelligent routing, real-time tracking, and dual-interface architecture (C++ Console + Web Application). Implements advanced data structures and algorithms for solving real-world logistics challenges.

## How to Add Topics to GitHub Repository

Topics can be added through the GitHub web interface:

1. Navigate to the repository on GitHub
2. Click on the ⚙️ gear icon next to "About" on the right sidebar
3. In the "Topics" field, add the relevant topics from the list above
4. Click "Save changes"

Recommended topics to add (select 10-20 most relevant):
```
courier-management, logistics, routing, tracking-system, data-structures,
```
